notes: Fastest DPI in throughput sweep, but this page shows many false positives: text labels such as Video/Image/File and normal bullets were converted into icons; several real note/warning icons were attached to the wrong nearby text.
Better than 200 DPI on this page: fewer false positives and correct inline refresh/disk/wrench icons, but note/warning callout icons were still missed or assigned to adjacent blocks.
Best qualitative result on this single page: similar false-positive count to 250 DPI, with one more inline operation icon judged correct; still not perfect because callout icons remained difficult.
